reviews.t: My only hair styler from now on!!
reviews.x: This hair dryer is amazing!  First of all it is so lightweight and easy to maneuver. Second it is fairly quiet for a hairdryer and doesn’t get so hot that it burns. I love all the different attachments that it comes with. I have very fine, thin hair and the curling attachment gives me great volume and style. This is now my new everyday tool!

I used my friends dyson while on vacation but just didn’t want to spend that much money. I found this one and decided to try it. Omg I’m so glad I did!! The drying power, easiness to use and just all around is just like the dyson!! I am very pleased and happy!!!!! I would 110% recommend

Finally, I can make my own hair style at home. It’s fun and very convenient to operate it. It’s easy to make hair curl inside or outside, you can be styling in a few minutes. The hair is heated evenly and naturally, you will feel similar to the barbershop job. So happy with it.

My hair is wavy so I have to constantly brush my hair as I’m drying it anyway. This hair drying brush combines the two and cuts out the extra step. I would say it took about the same amount of time as regular hair dryer - maybe 2-3 minutes more - but it feels less damaging to my hair and I didn’t have to put as much work into it afterwards. Instead of hair all over the place it seemed smoother as well. Solid additional tool to use on my hair.

reviews.t: Product Functionality and controlling features is good.
reviews.x: My wife liked this product. This product change her hair look.  Product Functionality and controlling features is good. Air temperature feature and ceramic coating technologies for providing constant temperature, is very impressive.  Now My wife take less time for her hair styling.

I have super corse curly hair … was able to get my hair super straight with no frizz … with less hassle than using a conventional blow dryer … cut my drying time in half … the different  attachments were incredibly useful for styling … recommend this product a 100% …

Absolutely love.  Easy to use and gives that salon blow out look/feel. Will be ordering a 2nd one because my daughter will definitely want her own. Only down fall is the gift card wont scan to complete the page.

reviews.t: Saves time, Easy to Use, Love this Set!
reviews.x: I absolutely love this dryer and brush set!! It has the feel of using a curling iron but you're styling and drying your hair. It has made getting ready so much faster and so much easier. Each brush does a different thing and styles my hair great. I would highly recommend this purchase and I think it would be great to give away for the upcoming holidays. When I'm ready to start drying my hair I use the attachment and do it in the same manner I would as if I was using a curling iron or a straight

Box was not secured with tape - anyone could have opened it along the way. Hair attachments appear to work but one does not connect correctly. Fine to use if you’re not expecting professional grade quality. Does have 2 levels of heat.

My old brush dryer died on me so I hurried up and hopped on Amazon so I could find something new during all the Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales. When this one popped up I said I think I should try it and I'm so glad I did. The accessories are awesome it's super easy to swap between the different types of dryers. The brush feature is awesome it makes your hair straight and smooth but not as limp as if you're using a flat iron. So it's great to be smooth straight with body instead of looking l

I love this ensemble and you will, too!!  I used to own the popular larger brush and with my thinner hair, it was just too much. So I thought I would give this one a whirl. Hair styling isn’t my forte, but I have fallen in love!! The different attachments are great and so much fun to experiment with. And it was perfect to help me create a good amount of volume with the smaller brush attachments. What’s not to love? It’s so pretty to boot!!

reviews.t: Fast and easy to use and beautiful gold color
reviews.x: I love this product since it’s very easy to use and has different interchangeable heads based off the style I’m trying to go for. It also comes with a heat resistant glove which helps with faster drying and avoiding burns. Also love the fact that it’s an actual golden color instead of a yellow color. Many products say gold but when you get them they are more yellow or copper to color than gold.

I love this hair dryer, except for it gets way to hot for my hair.  I mean when using this my hair gets too hot to touch. Everything else I love.  It's easy to use, lightweight, the brushes grip my hair but doesn't pull it out, and it leaves my hair pretty smooth.

Cheaply made! Two of the brush heads wouldn’t hook in, so they flew across the room when I tried to use them! It doesn’t work very well on wet hair…should be almost dry to use! All in all, not impressed!

reviews.t: Amazing tool, will be recommending to all!!
reviews.x: I love the way I can dry and style my hair at the same time!! What used to take me 30 minutes to do now takes 10-15 and my hair has so much more volume now that I’m solely using this. Love the product :)

reviews.t: The best I’ve used.  I love it!
reviews.x: Easy to quick change the brushes. Dries beautifully and doesn’t over dry or burn. Better than some of the super expensive ones I’ve used. I’m actually going to buy another to have on hand!

reviews.t: Exactly the hair tool I needed.
reviews.x: I couldn't have asked for an easier to use tool.

reviews.t: Easy to use and good price.
reviews.x: I tried my daughters air brush and really liked it, this one is so much better than what she had and the cost was about the same.  This gives so many choices of brushes and you can use it just as a hair dryer, hers was only the brush..  I hate sometimes brushing my hair while drying it because sometimes I get my hair tangled but haven’t had a problem with this. It’s easy to change the bushes and with the glove you can’t burn yourself.  They also include a glove for the heat.  I read that it didn

reviews.t: Works well for drying straight hair
reviews.x: I have super fine, straight hair and was looking for something easier to use than the two-handed charade with the traditional bulky hair dryer and big round brush.  My shoulders can’t handle it anymore. This dryer works pretty well, both drying and rounding off the ends with little effort on my part. I can do it quickly and one-handed now.  It is not great for drying really wet hair, but it is good once your hair is already half or mostly dry and you are ready to style. I haven’t tried using the

I got this product last year before the holidays. when it arrived I noticed the material of the brushes was not ceramic which immediately disappoint me and also made me think of the hair damage the metal can cause to the hair. I decided to give it a try because price wise it was a great deal for the many different heads it offers. It had been working OK so far, though I noticed it would overheat and made me worried about the hair damage but also the product performance. This morning as I'm dryin

Granted, I haven’t used all of the attachments yet but I will say so far the blow, big roller, straightening tools so far are amazing. It works SO fast and is really easy to use. It is super lightweight and not huge so when I put it in my carry on it isn’t taking up too much room. I’m mainly bummed that I didn’t get one sooner. I can’t wait to try out all of the feat

I used it just now for the fist time. It was so much easier to use than a normal hair dryer and brush. I wanted the dyson air wrap set, but I cannot justify paying that much for a hairdryer. Especially when paying a good penny on hair care products. This was a great experience! My hair is fine but I have a lot of it and past my shoulders. I have been on a natural hair journey since I cut my hair into a pixie two years ago. This was nicer on my hair, I have less frizz, my hair doesn’t feel dry at

I'm so excited about all the different attachments and I love the black and gold colors. It is so chic and it comes beautifully packed. I also love the heat resistant glove. reviews.t: Not sure if this company is genuine!
reviews.x: This company offers a $30.00 rebate with their product, they send you a code # but no way to redeem the code! Not sure if this is genuine at this point!I have very thick hair so I put this to the test if it could do the job on my hair, it really does a great job. I finished doing my hair in less time than I would using my old dryer! My only point with this product is it took me a little while to get used to changing the different heads on the brush. Once you get the hang of it, it’s easy!

This dryer and its attachments are a great assortment. This is good, because the moment I tried to insert an attachment, the small plastic nobs that lock it in broke off! So I used the next larger attachment, then one day it fell out, hit the floor, and both its nobs broke off! These nobs are a major weakness of this product. Since I bought this a few months ago,  I am hoping this is covered by the warranty. Very disappointed in this issue.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how easy the product is to use and how it speeds up drying and styling time.
Many reviewers love the interchangeable attachments and find them useful for different styling needs.
Several reviewers say it delivers salon-quality results, leaving hair smooth and reducing frizz.
A few reviewers report quality and heat issues, including attachments that don't connect properly and the dryer getting too hot.
Some reviewers note the product is lightweight and quiet.
